selection.detector_checkpoint: existing B0 checkpoint selected on Val
selection.qccr_coefficients: checkpoint-specific Val fit at predeclared lambda=1e-3
selection.umr_weights: checkpoint-specific Train fit at fixed head seed 0 and positive weight 4

data_roles.Val: fit checkpoint-specific QCCR coefficients and provide diagnostics
data_roles.Test: final reporting only after all three seeds are frozen

interpretation: Tests whether the frozen QCCR-UMR path improves B0 without GCCS training. It is a two-gate control, not a replacement for the cumulative or internal training-side ablations.
